decisions.markdown_control: Accept/Approve checkbox on a suggestion (parse_section decision checkboxes, suggestion-parser.py:812-822): checked = approve, unchecked = skip.
Keep Source checkbox on a suggestion (suggestion-parser.py:818-819): keep the origin inbox note instead of deleting it.
Delete Source checkbox on a suggestion (suggestion-parser.py:820-821): explicitly delete the origin.
Force Atomic checkbox on a suppressed light block (suggestion-parser.py:814-815): promote it to a full atomic note.
Title/Suggested name/Suggested title/Name field line on a suggestion (suggestion-parser.py:886-889): retype to rename; the filename derives from it.
Template field line on a suggestion (suggestion-parser.py:908-910): retype the template wikilink target.
Destination/Location/Move to field line on a suggestion (suggestion-parser.py:903-906): retype the destination folder.
Tags/Tag/New tags to add field line on a suggestion (suggestion-parser.py:891-892): retype the tag list to add.
Approve/Skip checkbox on a Proposed MOC block (parse_proposed_mocs, suggestion-parser.py:1136-1147).
Name field line on a Proposed MOC block (suggestion-parser.py:1160-1161): retype to rename the MOC.
Parent field line on a Proposed MOC block (suggestion-parser.py:1162-1163): retype to reparent.
Tags/Tag/New tags/Suggested tags field line on a Proposed MOC block (suggestion-parser.py:1166-1167).
Accept checkbox under a daily note's Possible Trackers block (parse_daily_updates, suggestion-parser.py:1851-1861).
Leading time token on a Possible Log Entries line, or the separate '- Time:' sub-field (parse_daily_updates, suggestion-parser.py:1886-1888, 1910-1928): retype to change when the entry lands.
Leading position token (a time, or after_last_line/before_first_line) on a Possible Log Entries line (suggestion-parser.py:1910-1928).
Text after the em dash on a Possible Log Entries line (suggestion-parser.py:1910-1928): retype to change the log-entry content.
Accept checkbox under a daily note's Possible Log Entries block (suggestion-parser.py:1851-1861).
Force Atomic Note checkbox on a Possible Log Entries item (suggestion-parser.py:1868-1875).
Accept checkbox under a daily note's Possible Log Links block (suggestion-parser.py:1851-1861).
Approve checkbox on a Tag-Handler Updates group block (_walk_tag_handler_decisions, suggestion-parser.py:2185-2187).
Keep source files checkbox on a Tag-Handler Updates group block (suggestion-parser.py:2182-2184).

Checkbox on a wikilinked MOC under a suggestion's 'Link to MOC:' header (parse_section, suggestion-parser.py:793-810): checking it links the MOC; checking an unlisted wikilink here adds a user-sourced candidate (source='user').
decisions.note: Functionally editable and round-tripped by build_from_wire, but suggestions-wire.schema.json's own field description does not carry the literal 'Editable' marker the T1.2 join reads off the schema side — a schema/parser discrepancy (finding, not resolved in T1.1). candidate_mocs[].source is the same control's side effect, not a separate decision.

decisions.markdown_control: Placement line following a checked MOC checkbox (parse_placement_line / _bind_candidate_anchor, suggestion-parser.py:787-791): overrides where the link is inserted.
decisions.note: Same schema-marker gap as D22 — functionally editable, not literally marked 'Editable' in suggestions-wire.schema.json.

decisions.markdown_control: Rename / Keep in inbox / Ignore checkboxes on an Attachment Conflicts entry (_walk_attachment_conflicts / _resolve_attachment_remedy, suggestion-parser.py:2268-2320+): the three ticks resolve to one remedy.
decisions.note: 037 state: the remedy has no wire field yet. This is the row F4's acceptance criteria name explicitly; Phase 2/T5.2 moves it off null when the field is added.
